source: Actual Granum dashboard with aerial-mini; no mocked metrics or API responses.

cues.text: Create a new object-detection project. This course uses aerial-walkthrough.
Choose the extracted aerial-mini folder. Keep both train and valid; there is no independent test set.
Preflight checks 96 training and 24 validation images before writing the project.
Read the ignore-region decision. Preserve regions as ignore/crowd; they are not ordinary target objects.
The import report records the applied decisions. The original source files are unchanged.
